prompt: Can you help me commit my staged changes? See changes.md for what's staged. Heads up: my team uses Linux/kernel-style commit messages (scope-prefixed), we do NOT use the feat:/fix: conventional commits style. Write the commit message(s) and save them to commit_msg.txt.

assertions.text: Recommends splitting the three unrelated changes into separate commits (does NOT cram them into a single commit)
Produces at least 2 (ideally 3) distinct commit messages
No subject line uses a conventional-commits type prefix (feat:/fix:/chore:/build:)
Subjects are imperative mood and roughly 50 characters or fewer
